extracted.intended_audience: EPA-regulated entities, petitioners, environmental organizations, attorneys, and other stakeholders involved in Title V operating permits and Federal Register notices
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register notice announcing EPA's final order on a petition to object to a State-issued Clean Air Act Title V operating permit, including contact information, legal citations, availability, and procedural instructions (e.g., judicial review deadlines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Officiality and verification of FederalRegister.gov content
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype of a 'Web 2.0' version of the daily Federal Register. It is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register, and does not replace the official print version or the official electronic version on GPO's govinfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format. While every effort has been made to ensure accurate display, those relying on it for legal research should verify their results against an official edition. Until the Administrative Committee of the Federal Register (ACFR) grants it official status, the XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Inspection / Official publication notice
rubrics_metrics.description: This PDF is FR Doc. [number] as it appeared on Public Inspection. Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If using public inspection listings for legal research, verify the contents of the documents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required notice sections / standard header fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal Register documents commonly include the following headings: AGENCY: ACTION: SUMMARY: FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These headings form the internal navigation and structure of notices; see document drafting guidance for placing substantive material under SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION and providing contact details under FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document heading metadata elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings vary by document type but may contain: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action listed in the Unified Agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Document Drafting Handbook for more details on what to include in document headings and how to format them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of administrative records and related documents
rubrics_metrics.description: The final order and petition are available electronically at: https://www.epa.gov/title-v-operating-permits/title-v-petition-database
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should state where the underlying petition and order can be accessed so interested parties can review the administrative record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comments status statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should clearly state whether public comments are being accepted and direct readers to the DATES and other relevant sections for procedural timing information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial review rights and filing deadline under the Clean Air Act
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections 307(b) and 505(b)(2) of the Clean Air Act provide that a petitioner may request judicial review of those portions of an order that deny issues in a petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any petition for review shall be filed in the United States Court of Appeals for the appropriate circuit no later than May 11, 2026. Notices asserting final agency orders should include statutory basis for judicial review and a firm filing deadline for petitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information for further inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a named contact with division, region, mailing address, telephone number, and email address (e.g., Zachary Stewart, Air and Radiation Division, EPA Region 8, address, telephone number, email).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should include clear FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT details so interested parties know whom to contact for questions or access to documents.
